Ellen (CS): FYI onboarding for NimbusHealth staging is noisy. They see a clean SDK init, then ~20s of 401s, then clients burst retries and we get 429s. They just flipped an internal edge-proxy in front of the app.
Sam (Eng): can you drop the SDK init and a sample 401 payload? Could be token TTL/clock skew or a token mint stampede from the proxy.
Ellen (CS): init: `const rw = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_TOKEN, env: 'staging' })`
Ellen (CS): example error: `401 {"error":"invalid_token","reason":"exp"}` then a bunch of `429 Too Many Requests` after rapid client retries. They said tokens are minted by a sidecar proxy that issues very short JWTs (3s TTL).
Luis (Support): sidecar minting 3s TTL -> very likely stampede. If many pods boot simultaneously and each asks proxy for a token, proxy will hit our auth endpoint repeatedly. Do they reuse connections to the proxy?
Sam (Eng): can we confirm their startup parallelism? Also ask for request-id from first 401 so we can correlate in logs.
Ellen (CS): they start ~30 pods in 45s during deploy. I'll ask for request-id and the Authorization header (trim token).
Sam (Eng): remediation suggestions we can give now:
- Configure proxy token cache: cache each minted JWT for ~5-10s (shorter than token TTL but prevents immediate re-mint).
- Singleflight per host: ensure only one in-flight mint per process, others wait on result.
- Add random jitter before refreshing: `sleep(rand(0,700ms))`
- Stagger pod startup by 1-3s if possible (deployment rollout settings).
- Increase ephemeral token TTL to at least 10s for rolling startups.
- Temporary measure: request a short staging quota bump while they deploy fix.
Ellen (CS): can you format that into a quick checklist I can send? Also they asked if we can bump their staging limits for ~90 minutes during the fix.
Luis (Support): we can approve a staging bump for 90m after infra review. I'll open INF ticket and request a soft bump. Need org id and env label.
Sam (Eng): add a small curl for verification after proxy change: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.example/v1/health` and confirm 200 + X-Request-Id header. Also ask them to capture first 401/429 pair headers for tracing.
Ellen (CS): sending checklist + ask for one 401/429 raw pair and the app logs around that time. I'll also ask them to enable debug logs on the proxy for token mint events.
infra-bot: [automated] Created ticket INF-8420: staging rate-limit bump requested (90m) by Luis (Support) for NimbusHealth (org:nimbus-staging).
Luis (Support): added org id and docs link to INF-8420. I'll set the bump to conservative +25% token endpoint QPS for 90m and monitor.
Sam (Eng): one more diagnostic: have them compare token `exp` claim with server time (we sometimes see TTL arithmetic bugs) and include `iat`/`exp` in the trimmed token so we can sanity-check.
Ellen (CS): great. I'll send everything. Will report back when they test the proxy cache. Thanks :raised_hands:
